scope: ContributionClaim vertical-slice records containing JSON null, booleans, integers, strings, arrays, and objects; non-integral numbers are outside this implemented subset
string_normalization: Unicode NFC after CRLF and CR are normalized to LF
object_order: normalized keys in Unicode code-point order; normalized duplicate keys are rejected
primitive_serialization: RFC-8785-compatible JSON literals for the supported null/boolean/integer/string subset
set_rule: normalize each member, sort by canonical encoded bytes, and reject canonical duplicates
